release_read.basis: Adjusted loss of $(0.60) misses Nasdaq's $(0.55) forecast and the FY adjusted operating margin guide of (4.5)%-(6.5)% confirms the fuel-driven cut; against that Q3 RASM +18.4%, a Q4 RASM guide of +18-22% with 1-2 pts of margin expansion and $2.2B liquidity plus $250M new aircraft financing defuse the distress thesis, so a small negative skew on a name with a 21% implied move.

vs_bar.consensus_source: Nasdaq EPS forecast carried in the brief (fallback, 8 estimates)

key_line.detail: Q4 RASM +18% to +22%, CASM ex-fuel -1% to +1%, 1-2 pts YoY margin expansion; liquidity $2.2B incl. $600M undrawn RCF, $250M aircraft financing to fund in Q4, ~$7B unencumbered assets.

guidance.detail: FY26 adjusted operating margin (4.5)% to (6.5)% at $3.95/gal fuel; Q4 fuel $4.64/gal. Prior FY guide not stated in the release; the hunt expected a fuel-driven FY cut.

call.detail: Call at 10:00 ET, inside the session; creditor co-op questions likely.

recommendation.reason: Voorlopig: de cijfers zijn gemengd en het gesprek met analisten om 10:00 brengt extra risico; verkopen bij de opening.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Een duidelijke stijging voorbeurs met veel handel.
